title.rendered: Edo CP hails peaceful LG poll, urges residents to remain law-abiding

content.rendered:
The Edo State Police Command has commended residents for the peaceful conduct recorded during Saturday’s local government elections, saying the exercise has so far remained calm across the state.

The command also urged members of the public to remain law-abiding, avoid actions capable of disrupting public peace and rely only on verified information as the electoral process winds down.

This was contained in a security update issued on Saturday by the Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Eno Ikoedem.

According to the statement, security agencies deployed across the state ensured a peaceful electoral process through coordinated operations and strategic deployment of personnel.

“The Edo State Police Command is pleased to inform the good people of Edo State that the ongoing Local Government Elections have, so far, been generally peaceful across the State.

“The comprehensive security arrangements put in place by the Command, in collaboration with other security agencies, have ensured a calm and orderly electoral process.

“Security personnel remain strategically deployed across the eighteen (18) Local Government Areas to safeguard voters, election officials, electoral materials, and other critical infrastructure,” the statement partly read.

The command said the Commissioner of Police, Monday Agbonika, monitored the elections by visiting the state’s three senatorial districts to assess security deployment and interact with officers on election duty.

It stated that the police commissioner expressed satisfaction with the conduct of security personnel and commended residents for their cooperation throughout the exercise.

“The Commissioner of Police, CP Monday Agbonika, fdc, has, since the early hours of today, toured the three Senatorial Districts of Edo State to assess the security deployment.

“During the visits, he interacted with officers on election duty, inspected security arrangements at strategic locations, and expressed satisfaction with the level of professionalism displayed by security personnel.

“He also commended the good people of Edo State for their peaceful conduct, patience, and cooperation, which have contributed significantly to the calm atmosphere witnessed across the State”, the statement continued.

The command also applauded other security agencies participating in the election, saying their collaboration was instrumental to the peaceful conduct of the polls.

“The Commissioner of Police also commends the unwavering professionalism, commitment, and synergy exhibited by sister security agencies involved in the election security operations.

“Their collaboration has been instrumental in ensuring the peaceful conduct of the elections and maintaining public confidence throughout the process.”

While noting that the elections had remained largely peaceful, the command appealed to residents to continue to act responsibly until the process is concluded.

“While the elections have remained largely peaceful, the Command urges members of the public to remain law-abiding, avoid acts capable of causing a breach of the peace, and continue to rely only on verified information from official sources as the electoral process draws to a close.”

The police reaffirmed their commitment to protecting lives and property and pledged to continue monitoring the situation until the conclusion of the election.

“The Edo State Police Command remains resolute in its commitment to ensuring the safety and security of all residents and will continue to monitor the process until its conclusion.

“The Command appreciates the continued support and cooperation of the people of Edo State and reassures the public of its unwavering dedication to protecting lives, property, and the sanctity of the democratic process,” the statement added.
